lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, specifically visible as four primary longitudinal chains of spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like lattice where the highest luminance maxima are located at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges along the upper lateral flank, defined by a distinct linear highlight on the dorsal edge and a parallel shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs localized on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's visible silhouette.
